author: Exiire_TSP
body:
The day August 20, 2016 at 6:40 PM, I was totally ban incongruously, Mrs. Midnightstorm, I banned to fly, without evidence, no video or photos, or anything.
I appeal to my desban, making me responsible that never broke the rules on any server.
Honestly, I hate to break the rules ... because I would want to?
Contact me.
I ask that justice be done!

Thank you.

replies.body:
Hello, Exiire_TSP!

Due to the video evidence of your ban having been deleted, I will be giving you the benefit of the doubt and accepting your appeal. Please ensure that you have read over the rules before coming onto the server here: http://avicus.net/rules.

Sorry for the inconvenience, and welcome back to Avicus. :)

Sincerely,
Liz//Midnightstorm
